batch_help: Ctrl/Shift-click to select multiple PAKs. Batch extraction keeps each archive in its own editable workspace.
credits_install_note: Install Evolve Stage 2 via modded-evolve.com before using this manager.
help_mod_body:
1. Choose a PAK in Make a Mod. Use Ctrl/Shift-click to select several.

2. Choose Unpack, or Unpack Selected to extract a batch into separate workspaces.

3. Edit Files opens your workspace. Save text with Ctrl+S, or right-click an asset to import/export, reveal or restore it.

4. Click Review, then Build Mod and Add Mod to stage your change. Every PAK builds separately.

Keep filenames and archive structure unchanged; incompatible replacement files are rejected.
help_play_body:
Before launching, Build Mod and Add Mod for each changed PAK.

Click Play With Mods and wait for the launcher to be ready. Press Play in the Modded Evolve client.

When finished, close both Evolve and the client, then select Restore Game Files.

Use Status Details or Activity for technical messages and recovery instructions.
help_setup_body:
Install Evolve Stage 2 through https://modded-evolve.com/ first.

Click Set Up Manager, choose your installed EvolveGame folder, then select the normal Modded Evolve client executable.

The manager creates a local custom-signed set and keeps your original installed files intact until a guided launch.

Settings contains stage, launch helper, and project paths. Advanced settings holds less-common export and filtering controls.
help_safety_body:
This is experimental, for offline/private testing only. Online services are not supported with modified assets. Do not attempt online play with a modded game.

Keep your Data folder when updating the manager; it contains keys, backups, staged PAKs and projects.

Never delete recovery journals or backups to bypass a failure. If an operation reports a problem, open Activity to inspect the error before continuing.

A successful signed build does not guarantee valid gameplay or model behavior.
editor_help_files: Choose Files / Text to edit compatible text or XML, then press Ctrl+S. Right-click for Import/Replace, Export and Restore actions. Structural CryXML edits are not supported. Files in your workspace are not installed until you build and add the PAK.
editor_help_images: Choose Images / Textures for DDS preview, PNG export, and matching DDS or PNG import. Incompatible formats, dimensions and mip layouts are rejected. Right-click on the extracted texture to see the supported actions.
editor_help_models: Choose Models to inspect supported CryEngine meshes and preview UV textures from unpacked PAKs. Right-click to export, find textures or use experimental same-layout import. GPU rendering is used when available; software fallback remains available.
